headline: Zonneveld beats Noppert to win the Dutch Darts Championship in Maastricht
standfirst: Niels Zonneveld won European Tour 15 on home soil, beating Danny Noppert 8-5 in an all-Dutch final and hitting 27 maximums.
body: Niels Zonneveld won the Dutch Darts Championship at the MECC in Maastricht, beating fellow Dutchman Danny Noppert 8-5 in the final. Zonneveld averaged 92.93 to Noppert's 87.66 and finished the final with a 157 checkout. Dartsnews described it as his maiden European Tour title.

Zonneveld had to come through the first round. He beat Mike De Decker 6-4, Krzysztof Ratajski 6-5 and Gerwyn Price 6-4, then edged Wessel Nijman 6-5 in the quarter-finals with a 102.06 average. He beat Stephen Bunting 7-4 in the semi-finals.
Noppert produced the best performance of the weekend in the quarter-finals. He averaged 113.42 to beat Luke Woodhouse 6-2, then beat Gian van Veen 7-5 in the semi-finals.
Cristo Reyes averaged 110.26 against Chris Dobey in the last 32. Martin Schindler hit the highest checkout, 164, against Karel Sedlacek.
Zonneveld hit 27 maximums, comfortably the most at the event, ahead of Noppert on 15.
